A uniquely declared same-batch new person may retain raw addition-only assignments at unchanged room count; no room or member is chosen by this guard. Explicit allocation edits retain their normal path. Unknown changed counts ask while preserving existing allocations.
finding.closing_condition: The same count-only input/patches preserve saved state; explicit new-child/redistribution remain possible, unknown count remains safe; related pure and real PG/ASGI assertions pass.

implementation.foreign_room_patch: Left for normal atomic unknown-target rejection, not silently retargeted

verification.new_PG_fact: A controlled model returns schema-valid swapped scoped patches on a count-only message; after the guard the own real PG trip/version remain identical, one injected model adapter call, no tools/orders.
verification.intermediate_fixture_failures: room-count-patch-first.xml kept two failures caused by an initially incomplete test baseline with no route legs; complete dated canonical fixture now includes owned existing legs. Strict trip/version assertions were retained.

downstream_boundaries.assessment: No new bypass found in reviewed code and related cases
downstream_boundaries.evidence: Dynamic schema correlates each existing stay const with its owned room-ID enum. Domain selects room inside the specified current stay; unknown travelers, duplicate allocation and invalid shape fail the atomic batch. New person aliases require an actual same-batch add operation before use.

downstream_boundaries.assessment: Draft structural validity is distinct from search/quote validity
downstream_boundaries.evidence: The new setter cannot change group flags. protect_group_separation restores previously true flags on unrelated upsert_group. Domain may retain an incomplete or incompatible draft; inventory fixed assignments and planning hotel binding reject mixed separate families, invalid occupancy and missing adult. No real-booking bypass is claimed.

Emptying or changing a room does not remove a traveler from the trip. guard_unapplied_traveler_removal checks explicit omitted removal independently of setter type and blocks the batch for ASK. remove_traveler cleans all room/group references; a later re-add of its removed ID fails final known-traveler validation.

API authorizes own session, paused worker does not execute queued mutations, _ensure_current_run and Store.finish_run apply shared state-version/lease fences. The new setter is a data operation and grants no resume or confirmation.

downstream_boundaries.assessment: Shared invalidation covers the new operation
downstream_boundaries.evidence: A real membership change is emitted as a stays change; Store.finish_run invalidates quotes whenever a new state is committed, independently of operation type. No-op patches preserve state. Existing related PG cases test stale quote rejection. Undo does not restore quote/order/consent.

separate_peer_finding.fact: A full rooms setter omitting a separately patched existing room was not a preflight conflict: patch->full could finish after dropping the target; full->patch failed unknown_target. Root was notified; this actor did not edit operation_conflicts.
separate_peer_finding.closing_condition: Preflight rejects a room patch whose target is absent from the same-batch full layout of that stay, regardless of operation order; retain valid scoped patches across different stays.
